messages:
maria: Heads-up 1: Acme asked for a rapid adaptive-routing rollout but with strict SLA gates. Need to lock the rollout plan + customer opt-in mechanics today. Quick takes?

alex: My draft: phased rollout by region with tenant opt-in and a canary A/B step. Phases: tiny internal canary -> 5% customers -> 25% -> 100%. Hold durations: 1h, 4h, 12h, 48h.

simon: We should be precise about the SLOs that gate progress. Proposal:
- P95 latency: no more than +12% vs baseline over the phase window
- Error rate (5xx): absolute delta <= 0.04%
- Model queue length: p99 < 30ms
- Any circuit-breaker trigger flips that tenant back immediately

jess: Legal wants a documented emergency rollback SLA: we must be able to remove any tenant from the experiment within 30 minutes and provide a named on-call. Acme also asked for a one-click pause in their account UI.

maria: We can do per-tenant opt-in and a UI toggle. Ops needs a global kill switch too. Also confirm customer communications timeline for Acme 1 - sales needs signoff.

alex: Quick API sketch for opt-in (to include in the deploy):
```
POST /api/v1/flags/adaptive_routing/tenants/:tenant_id/optin
{ "opt_in": true }
```
We'll add `GET /api/v1/flags/:flag/status?tenant=:id` for visibility.

eva: Telemetry requirements: every request should surface `routing_variant`, `cohort`, `decision_ts`, `upstream_queue_ms`, and `model_latency_ms`. Capture 1% of traces with full spans for failed or high-latency requests. Dashboards: per-region p50/p95, 5xx, and a cohort breakdown.

simon: Runtime actions: auto-fallback rule when a shard reports > 10 consecutive failures in 5m OR if p95 exceeds baseline by 25% for any 1h window. Alert to PagerDuty and flip opt-out for affected tenant.

jess: Acme specifically wants a manual hold point at 25% for their SLA customers. Can product add a pre-approved hold that only Acme's admins can trigger?

alex: We can implement a tenant-scoped hold flag: `tenant_hold:true` that pauses ramp for that tenant slice. Expose it in Console and through the API.

maria: Draft launch checklist:
- Staging canaries run and pass smoke tests (routing_variant present, no spike in 5xx)
- Production telemetry validated and dashboards created
- Rollback playbook + on-call roster published
- Console opt-in UI and tenant hold tested
- Legal + Sales signoff for Acme timeline

eva: I'll upload dashboard JSON and perf queries before the preflight. Also add a regression query that compares current p95 to 7-day baseline.

simon: I'll wire circuit-breaker metrics into runtime and add the auto-fallback flow. Will also create an Ops dashboard with an explicit big red "Kill Switch" button.

ops-bot: #incidents/adaptive-routing-3623456789 channel created for rollout coordination.

deploy-bot: Staging CI pipeline scheduled for 2026-04-05T20:00Z; tentative prod canary (us-east-1) 2026-04-06T02:00Z.

jess: Customer expectation: Acme wants the option to opt ~10 priority customers into first slice. Sales needs a list of tenant IDs and a signed addendum.

maria: Open action items: 1) final SLO thresholds (simon + eva) 2) console/UX for tenant hold & opt-in (product + devex) 3) API + integration tests (alex) 4) sales/legal addendum + contact list (jess) 5) runbook + automatic rollback rules (simon). Preflight check Friday 09:30 PT.

alex: I'll add an automated smoke test that asserts `routing_variant` header and verifies 5xx delta < 0.02% during staging canary.

simon: Also recommend we add a short-lived shadow mode option (no routing changes, only telemetry) so Acme can evaluate quality before ramping.

maria: Good idea. Let's include a 24h shadow phase in the plan by default. If no objections I'll lock this plan and ping Acme with the timeline after preflight. :thumbsup:
